decisions.summary: The torii pitch is 12 ft (two ken), a guess inside the GM's 10-13 ft band
decisions.why: FR-010 asks for a single value within 10-13 ft; 12 is one; labeled a guess inside a GM ruling

decisions.summary: Every avenue laid at the pitch; the cap-and-band rule and the ~30 ft village exception retired; the village roll uses the same stride and threshold; the designated donation-row sites keep their exemption, stated in the rewritten rule and entry 090
decisions.why: FR-010 and US3 scenarios 1-2 ('every avenue at every scale', town/city re-laid, 'designated donation-row sites keep their exemption'). Round 1's gap (D2 silent on the exemption) is closed: the exemption is now carried explicitly and is the spec's own, not a new carve-out

decisions.summary: The arch glyph drawn in plan at true size (kasagi bar plus two post squares), stroke floor as convention
decisions.why: FR-011: a glyph that does not overlap at 1/2/3 ft/px and still reads as an arch, its class recorded at the point of change; the GM's 'the drawing floor needs a look'

decisions.summary: The wall-shortening floor at the glyph's drawn depth plus one px, never above the pitch
The sheet's arch in plan per D3; the elevation-depth disclosure retires with the glyph
decisions.why: FR-008 (arches at the new pitch) and FR-011

decisions.summary: The grove outline with the shrine well at its back edge to the outermost arch, ~120 ft wide at the hall narrowing to ~60 ft on the avenue, ~620 tsubo estimated, measured at T-map and trimmed if above 650; the band T-program writes is R2's figures as found, never widened to fit
decisions.why: FR-007 (every side of hall and sanctuary; the well in the grove or at its edge; forward to the outermost arch; area inside the band FR-005 records). Round 1's condition is met: the band is R2's as found and the grove answers to it, not the reverse. If a trim is needed it must come off the width - FR-007 fixes the reach from the well to the outermost arch - which the plan does not contradict

decisions.summary: The sacred tree stands beside the approach, inside the grove
decisions.why: Round 1 ruled the north-east-of-the-sanctuary seat NOT LEGITIMATE. The revision seats it by the GM's own words ('the sacred tree and a stone basin by the approach') and FR-007/US2 ('a sacred tree and a stone basin beside the approach'), a placement every reading of the ruling accepts. No longer a narrowing

decisions.summary: The stone basin beside the approach at the innermost arch, on the side opposite the tree
decisions.why: FR-006, FR-007: 'a stone basin beside the approach'; which side is not addressed by the request

decisions.summary: Manifest entries: village_groves role shrine, tree_crowns the sacred tree, wells the basin flagged basin, torii the seven at the pitch
decisions.why: FR-007: the drawing and the manifest edited together, so matches_map holds the sheet to them (US2 scenario 2)

decisions.summary: no_precinct_enclosure replaces fence_not_wall: a fence, wall or hedge enclosing the hall fails; a sanctuary-only fence passes
decisions.why: FR-004 (a sheet that draws a precinct enclosure fails the program check) and the spec's edge case keeping a sanctuary-only fence as a wealth item; enforcement of the request

decisions.summary: The hand edit: the mirror's gitignored svg edited in place and the png re-rasterized with the gen's resvg call; manifest and notes carry the edit in git; the gen's SHRINE_TORII stride brought to the pitch
decisions.why: FR-007 (drawing and manifest together, notes record the edit, not regenerated); aligning the gen's stride keeps a future conversion on the edited avenue. Where the edit is made is process, not fidelity

decisions.summary: The crop check's viewbox_cropped row stops excusing on-map sheets; frame_is_the_maps removed; buildings.md revised; matches_map still holds every map feature inside the frame
tasks.md T03 lists a sanctuary fence among the wealth-knob items, none at average
decisions.why: The spec's edge case: 'Whether a richer shrine may draw one is recorded as a wealth-knob item, not a precinct boundary'; D7 lets it pass the enclosure check

decisions.summary: Subsidiary shrines, office, votive-plaque hall, portable-shrine store not drawn; the no-worship-hall form and the Chinese opera stage disclosed, not knobs
decisions.why: FR-006 carries 'the knobs the research directs'; R4 found no village-scale evidence for the first four, and the one-roof hall is the program's existing GM form, which the request does not touch
